name: Ancien au sceptre de clan
description: A broad-shouldered elderly male chief with pale ochre freckled skin, a wide heavy brow and deep facial grooves. Thick silver-streaked dreads fall over one shoulder. He wears a wine-red ceremonial robe with a broad collar of small carved bone slats, layered bronze waist plaques and dark wrapped greaves. Right hand calmly grips a tall ring-headed bronze sceptre beside his body; left hand rests over his belt. Robust dignified silhouette.
